task_description: Build the Hotel OS hotel dashboard — a complete, premium B2B SaaS dashboard for hotel owners, managers, and staff. Covers: dashboard layout (sidebar + topbar), overview page, reservations list + detail, room management, inventory calendar, staff management, analytics, subscription, payouts, and hotel profile. All pages use mock data. Built in Next.js 16.4 / React 19 / Tailwind CSS 4 under app/dashboard/.
